summary: Viewed the four supplied actual PNGs, including the native 128px portrait and all 18 poses at native 1x and nearest 3x on light, dark and checker backgrounds. The broad teal pine crown, reddish split trunk, pale root beard, gold facial accents, two branch arms and two root feet read as the same tree king throughout. Warm upper-left highlights and broad dark trunk planes give readable wooden volume; the crown remains distinguishable on the dark background. No obvious unintended transparent holes, missing limb outlines or floating hands are visible; the open spaces inside bent arms and between legs read as intentional negative space. Standing feet share the ground line, the dash and strike widen the stance, hit bends the trunk, and dead forms a grounded collapsed pile. Windup, move, downward strike and recovery are visually distinct, although the strike hand becomes larger and the static images cannot establish whether that transition feels smooth. The skill progresses from a green-gold core at the front root foot to three rising woody stems connected at that foot, then a retained stump and separated wood fragments; this is a rooted effect consistent with the foot-based brief, with the folded hand adjacent to the inner stem. Poison uses a hunched, mouth-covering pose and purple bubbles; stun uses a slack front arm and stars; sleep uses bent knees, a lowered crown and closed-eye facial marks. These are readable posture changes, not recolors or unrelated attacks; motion within each status pair is restrained. This is a visual keep recommendation for the supplied pose preview, not a user selection or approval of actual battle playback. PNGs alone do not verify literal pixel authorship, model provenance, palette/alpha compliance, animation timing, dash translation or contact with a battle target; geometry PASS would not establish those either.
